title: Seoul · Gangwon Mountain Run
slogan: A long mountain-and-coast day for early starts.
story: A long mountain-and-coast day for early starts. A 390 km loop that starts and ends near Hongch’ŏn, about 7 h 30 of riding. The stops in between: Gangneung coast and Odaesan  roads. Daegwallyeong high road is the high point. It tops out at about 800 m. It is a high-mountain day. The plan has 1 fuel stop marked.

sections.advice: Use Seoul start → Hongcheon fuel as clean positioning. Keep it tidy, ignore impatient traffic and save the enthusiasm for the good road ahead. The value here is not drama; it is arriving at the riding section with space, fuel and concentration intact.

This Daegwallyeong high road → Gangneung coast stretch is for rhythm and scenery. Keep your head up, let the view breathe, and resist turning every open bend into a target. Stop once properly rather than half-stopping everywhere.

scenicChapters.title: Daegwallyeong high road → Gangneung coast
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 29 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

title: Seoul · Bukhan River and Gapyeong Roads
slogan: A 133 km loop out of Namyangju river
story: River roads and mountain edges outside the capital. 133 km round from Namyangju - plan on about 2 h 18 of riding. On the way it passes Gapyeong lake road and Cheongpyeong. The plan has 1 food stop and 1 fuel stop marked.
